title: Display the Packing Slip list
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Click Inventory from the side menu
2. Click Packing Slip
exp: A table listing all Packing Slips in the system is displayed

title: Add Packing Slip button is displayed
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Verify that the Add Packing Slip button is displayed on the list screen
exp: The Add Packing Slip button is visible and clickable

title: Navigate to the Add Packing Slip screen
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Click the Add Packing Slip button
exp: The user is redirected to the Add Packing Slip screen
rem: Needs Clarification: SRS says the button redirects to the 'Add Delivery Note' screen. Assumed to be a typo for Add Packing Slip.

title: Display checkbox column for row selection
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Open the Packing Slip list
exp: A checkbox is displayed next to each row and supports multiple selection

title: Display Packing Slip ID column
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Open the Packing Slip list
exp: The Packing Slip ID column is displayed for each row

title: Navigate to Packing Slip Details by clicking the ID
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Click a Packing Slip ID in the table
exp: The user is redirected to the Packing Slip Details screen of the selected slip

title: Display Status column with a valid value
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Open the list and review the Status column
exp: Each row shows exactly one of: Draft, Submitted, Cancelled

title: Status of a newly saved Packing Slip is Draft
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Add and save a new Packing Slip
2. Return to the list
exp: The new Packing Slip appears in the list with status Draft

title: Status changes to Submitted after submission
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Submit a Draft Packing Slip
2. Return to the list
exp: The status is Submitted

title: Status changes to Cancelled after cancellation
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Cancel a Submitted Packing Slip
2. Return to the list
exp: The status is Cancelled

title: Display Delivery Note column
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Open the list and review the Delivery Note column
exp: The Delivery Note associated with each Packing Slip is displayed

title: Action bar appears when one row is selected
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Select the checkbox of one Packing Slip
exp: An action bar appears showing the available actions

title: Action bar appears when multiple rows are selected
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Select the checkboxes of three Packing Slips
exp: The action bar is displayed and applies to the selected rows

title: Action bar disappears when all rows are deselected
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select one Packing Slip
2. Clear the checkbox
exp: The action bar is no longer displayed

title: Action bar contains the required actions
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Select a Packing Slip and review the action bar
exp: The action bar contains: Edit, Export, Assign to, Clear assignment, Add tags, Print (Submit, Cancel and Delete are shown only by status)

title: Open the Edit popup
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a Packing Slip
2. Click Edit
exp: A popup is displayed containing the Field dropdown, the Value field and the Update button

title: Field dropdown is a single-selection list of editable fields
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Open the Edit popup
2. Open the Field dropdown
3. Try to select two options
exp: The dropdown lists the fields of the Packing Slip and allows selecting only one option

title: Click Update without selecting a Field
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Open the Edit popup
2. Leave Field empty
3. Click Update
exp: An error message is displayed because Field is mandatory

title: Value input type changes dynamically based on the selected Field
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Open the Edit popup
2. Select Field = Letter Head and note the Value input type
3. Select Field = Gross Weight and note the Value input type
exp: The Value field changes its input type (searchable dropdown for Letter Head, numeric input for Gross Weight)

title: Value field is marked mandatory or optional according to the selected Field
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Open the Edit popup
2. Select a mandatory field (e.g., Series)
3. Leave Value empty and click Update
exp: The Value field is flagged as mandatory and an error message is displayed

title: Value field applies the validation rules of the selected Field
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Open the Edit popup
2. Select Field = Gross Weight
3. Enter letters and click Update
exp: A validation error message is displayed and the slip is not changed

title: Update a Draft Packing Slip successfully
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a Draft Packing Slip
2. Click Edit
3. Select Field = Letter Head
4. Select a Value
5. Click Update
exp: The Packing Slip is updated successfully
rem: Needs Clarification: SRS defines only the error case of Update (Submitted / Cancelled). The Draft success case is assumed.

title: Update a Submitted Packing Slip
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a Submitted Packing Slip
2. Click Edit
3. Select a Field and a Value
4. Click Update
exp: An error message is displayed informing the user that the Packing Slip cannot be modified

title: Update a Cancelled Packing Slip
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a Cancelled Packing Slip
2. Click Edit
3. Select a Field and a Value
4. Click Update
exp: An error message is displayed informing the user that the Packing Slip cannot be modified

title: Edit with multiple Packing Slips selected
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select two Draft Packing Slips
2. Click Edit
3. Select a Field and a Value
4. Click Update
exp: To be confirmed with the BA (bulk edit behavior)
rem: Needs Clarification: SRS does not say whether Edit supports multi-selection.

title: Submit action is displayed for a Draft Packing Slip
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Select a Draft Packing Slip and review the action bar
exp: The Submit action is displayed

title: Submit action is hidden for Submitted and Cancelled slips
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Select a Submitted slip and a Cancelled slip and review the action bar
exp: The Submit action is not displayed

title: Submit a Draft Packing Slip with complete and valid data
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a complete Draft Packing Slip
2. Click Submit
exp: The Packing Slip is submitted successfully and its status changes to Submitted

title: Submit a Draft Packing Slip with incomplete data
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a Draft slip with a missing mandatory value
2. Click Submit
data: Draft slip without Gross Weight UOM
exp: The slip is not submitted, a validation error is displayed and the status stays Draft
rem: Needs Clarification: SRS describes only the success case of Submit.

title: Submit multiple Draft Packing Slips at once
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select two complete Draft slips
2. Click Submit
exp: To be confirmed with the BA (bulk submit behavior)
rem: Needs Clarification: SRS does not define bulk submit.

title: Cancel action is displayed for a Submitted Packing Slip
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Select a Submitted Packing Slip and review the action bar
exp: The Cancel action is displayed

title: Cancel action is hidden for Draft and Cancelled slips
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Select a Draft slip and a Cancelled slip and review the action bar
exp: The Cancel action is not displayed

title: Cancel a Submitted Packing Slip
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a Submitted Packing Slip
2. Click Cancel
exp: The Packing Slip is cancelled successfully and its status changes to Cancelled
rem: Needs Clarification: SRS spells the status 'Cancelled' in the list and 'Canceled' in the Add screen. Confirm the exact label.

title: Cancelling a Packing Slip affects the linked Delivery Note
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Cancel a Submitted Packing Slip
2. Open its Delivery Note
exp: To be confirmed with the BA (Delivery Note packing information is updated)
rem: Needs Clarification: SRS does not describe the effect of submit / cancel on the Delivery Note.

title: Delete action is displayed for a Submitted Packing Slip
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Select a Submitted Packing Slip and review the action bar
exp: The Delete action is displayed
rem: Needs Clarification: SRS says Delete appears only when the status is Submitted.

title: Delete action for Draft and Cancelled slips
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps: Select a Draft slip and a Cancelled slip and review the action bar
exp: To be confirmed with the BA (Delete is hidden as written in the SRS)
rem: Needs Clarification: As written, Delete is available only for Submitted slips, so a Draft or Cancelled slip cannot be deleted. This looks inverted compared with other modules.

title: Confirmation message is displayed when clicking Delete
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a Submitted Packing Slip
2. Click Delete
exp: A confirmation message asks the user whether they want to delete this Packing Slip

title: Cancel the delete confirmation
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a Submitted slip
2. Click Delete
3. Click No (or close the message)
exp: The slip is not deleted and remains in the list
rem: Needs Clarification: SRS describes only the Yes button.

title: Delete a Packing Slip that has no links
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select an unlinked Submitted Packing Slip
2. Click Delete
3. Click Yes
exp: The Packing Slip is deleted successfully and removed from the list

title: Delete a Packing Slip that was amended from another slip
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a slip that has Amended From populated
2. Click Delete
3. Click Yes
exp: A warning message is displayed: the slip cannot be deleted until all related doctypes are deleted. The slip is not deleted

title: Linked doctypes in the amended-slip warning are hyperlinks
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Trigger the delete warning for an amended slip
2. Click a linked doctype in the warning
exp: Linked doctypes are shown as hyperlinks and the user is redirected to the corresponding doctype

title: Delete a Packing Slip linked to other transactions
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select a slip linked to other transactions (e.g., Shipment)
2. Click Delete
3. Click Yes
exp: A message informs the user that the linked transactions must be deleted first. The slip is not deleted

title: Linked transactions in the delete message are hyperlinks
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Trigger the delete message for a linked slip
2. Click a linked transaction in the message
exp: Linked transactions are shown as hyperlinks and the user is redirected to the corresponding doctype

title: Delete multiple Packing Slips at once
pre: Access via Inventory > Packing Slip
steps:
1. Select two unlinked Submitted slips
2. Click Delete
3. Click Yes
exp: To be confirmed with the BA (bulk delete behavior)
rem: Needs Clarification: SRS does not define bulk delete.
